purpose: Accurate inventory of extracted runtime blocks and their current responsibilities.
policy: Keep shared-global scripts as classic deferred scripts in the documented order. Avoid duplicate agent flows; the existing agent registration, funding, and recharge UI lives in js/features/customer/customer-home.js.

modules.js/core/legacy-main-controller.js: Legacy main controller: maps, geocoding, A/B route, fare, ride request/search/acceptance state, navigation, and driver registration. Mixed responsibilities remain intentionally together because of shared globals.
modules.js/features/customer/ride-booking.js: Safety-page setup plus passenger acceptance polling and accepted-trip tracking helpers.
modules.js/features/customer/customer-home.js: Customer account settings and the existing agent registration, approval-status, wallet funding request, driver lookup, and recharge workflows.
modules.js/services/cloud-session-tracking.js: Supabase-backed auth/session, cloud request loading, passenger trip tracking and resume behavior.
modules.js/core/navigation.js: Navigation and driver request-detail page compatibility helpers.
modules.js/services/supabase-client.js: Driver settings UI and saved preferences (despite the filename, not the Supabase client singleton).
modules.js/features/driver/driver-dashboard.js: Driver dashboard bottom-navigation and section visibility controller.
modules.js/features/driver/ride-requests.js: Driver application approval portal and staff-only visibility checks (not the live trip queue).
modules.js/features/agent/agent-registration.js: Quick price suggestion buttons for the driver request UI (not agent registration).
modules.js/features/admin/driver-approval.js: Driver request map UI and map lifecycle helpers (not the standalone admin approval page).
modules.js/features/agent/customer-recharge.js: Deprecated, intentionally not loaded. The old file force-hid menu shortcuts; the actual agent recharge flow remains in customer-home.js.
modules.js/features/maps/map-controller.js: Primary map/location selection and route-control helpers.
modules.js/features/admin/agent-approval.js: Standalone admin.html dashboard for driver/agent approval and funding requests.
modules.js/features/driver/ride-request-ui.js: Driver request-detail modal/page helpers; relies on shared legacy globals and demo cards are removed when live dispatch initializes.
modules.js/features/driver/live-ride-dispatch.js: Live driver request queue, approval/online checks, location sync, real RPC acceptance, realtime subscription, polling fallback, and trip completion.
modules.js/features/driver/merchant-portal.js: Merchant application submission and staff-only merchant/agent application review portal.
modules.js/features/agent/agent-funding.js: Unused planned extraction target; funding UI remains in customer-home.js.
